headline: IonQ and Tennessee utility EPB have launched a webinar programme to help businesses in six industries start using quantum computing.
score_reason: Announced at a 2 Oct 2026 conference, before the window; a training programme rather than a technology or sales result.
importance_line: Company managers get a step-by-step route to try quantum tools, though no customer results are given.
source: The Quantum Insider, carrying an EPB Quantum press release
summary: The Quantum Insider carries an EPB Quantum press release saying EPB and IonQ, a quantum computer maker, launched CQ Connect, a webinar series giving business leaders a step-by-step guide to applying quantum computing, with tracks for biotech and healthcare, insurance, financial services, automotive and manufacturing, chemicals and materials, and logistics. It was announced on 2 Oct 2026 at the Quantum in Business conference in Chattanooga, Tennessee, which drew more than 450 people.
notes: Original (TipRanks) blocked; built from Quantum Insider press release and Quantum Zeitgeist coverage of the same event. Source is a press release, not independent reporting.
